text:
Maya: Quick sync: designing resumable prefetch checkpoint format + admission controls. Posting a concise sketch.

Jihoon: Goal: resume must be safe across lease handoff. Prefer tiny durable records with epoch CAS.

Taylor: Two constraints: low IO for hot prefixes and simple verification on resume.

Nora: Options: (1) single blob per prefix + epoch CAS (simple, rewrite cost), (2) append-only WAL small tuples + compaction (write-heavy but resumable), (3) hybrid in-memory fast path + periodic durable checkpoint.

Sam: For production we should favor (2) with compaction heuristics and admission controls to avoid IO storms.

Maya: Invariant: resume only allowed when persisted.epoch <= current_lease. If epoch < lease, resume must verify progress digest; mismatch -> full re-prefetch.

Jihoon: Use a 64-bit rolling digest (or XOR of chunk ids) in checkpoint to cheaply compare progress. Digest match -> continue; digest mismatch -> restart. False-positive risk very low.

Taylor: Checkpoint lifecycle: append deltas during prefetch, compact into summary on completion or size threshold (e.g., 4KB). GC entries when epoch advances beyond safe window.

Nora: Durability: write append -> fsync (or use lease-store durability) -> then ack resumability to runtime. Avoid acking client before durable progress.

Sam: Admission control knobs: max_concurrent_resume_per_prefix, resume_queue_depth_per_node. On overflow return 429 and increment prefetch.resume_rejected.

Maya: Metrics: prefetch.checkpoint_write_latency_ms, prefetch.resume_attempts_total, prefetch.resume_rejected_total, prefetch.resume_digest_mismatch_total. Alert if resume_rejected or write p99 spikes.

Jihoon: Checkpoint store key/value proposal: key=prefix_id, value=base64(v1|epoch|digest|completed|tuples). Keep <4KB normally and versioned. Missing checkpoint -> treat as no-progress.

Taylor: Testing: unit digest match/mismatch, chaos crash after append before fsync, load test 10k hot prefixes to measure IO+GC, integration demote-mid-prefetch to assert no double-reply.

Nora: Rollout: dry-run WAL+metrics -> canary (2 pods) with admission limits -> gradual percent rollout with dashboards. Rollback: switch to demote_prefetch_grace_ms=100 and turn feature-flag off if digest_mismatch > threshold or p99 write latency > 500ms.

Maya: Next actions: Jihoon mock lease-store CAS + checkpoint API, Nora prototype WAL+compactor, Taylor draft RFC+tests, Sam add admission knobs + dashboards. I'll open canary ticket and wire metrics. Sync in 48h with RFC/PR links here.

Sam: +1

Jihoon: I'll post integration test snippets once mocked.
